requirements.evidence: app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php:38,48,60,94 reference `TicketStatus::Called/Waiting` but there is no `use App\Enums\TicketStatus;` (imports at :5-12), so PHP resolves `App\Actions\TicketStatus` and every call fatals with class-not-found. Separately, the PriorityOnly/NormalOnly branches (:66-71) add no orderBy, so the selection is nondeterministic and breaks rule 2/3. The re-check loop (:89-102) cannot work: the query already filters `waiting`, and a non-waiting candidate would cause `continue` forever. The enum (app/Enums/CallMode.php) and the exception (app/Exceptions/NoWaitingTicketsException.php) match the contract.

conventions.evidence: The domain write correctly lives in app/Actions/CallNextTicket.php. No tests ship despite 'No production code without a test'. No CHANGELOG entry. The imports are not sorted (:10 `InactiveQueueException` after `User`), which Pint will flag. Both doc edits are mangled: docs/architecture.md:122-131 inserts a paragraph in the middle of the sentence 'from successfully ... calling the same waiting ticket', and docs/business-rules.md:123 puts a new `## Call the next ticket` H2 between the `### Call Panel` heading and its table.

security.evidence: Authorization is out of scope per task.md. The queue state is re-read under lockForUpdate (:23-26). Candidate rows are selected with lockForUpdate (:62). The history query (:37-43) has no lock but runs under the queue lock. No user input is involved. The concurrency safety depends on code that currently cannot run.

tests.evidence: The diff has no test files at all: no Pest tests for ordering, modes, fairness, the inactive queue, the empty queue or concurrency.

simplicity.evidence: The restriction logic is split across two places (:64-65 adds a where, :82-86 adds ordering separately) instead of applying the ordering once. The switch has a redundant `case CallMode::Any: default:`. The while(true) loop (:89) adds no value.

readability.evidence: There is a leftover debug comment `// status enum string? check` (:38) and an unused `use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;` (:11). The comment on the `continue` branch is misleading ('Refresh and continue' when refreshing cannot change the query result). The ordering logic is scattered.

scope.evidence: Only the action, the enum, the exception and the two docs the task requested are touched.

issues.explanation: `TicketStatus` is used but not imported, so it resolves to the non-existent `App\Actions\TicketStatus` and every invocation throws a fatal Error.
No tests ship with the new action, which violates the mandatory TDD convention and leaves ordering, fairness, modes and the error paths unverified.
The PriorityOnly and NormalOnly modes apply no ORDER BY, so `first()` returns an arbitrary ticket instead of the highest-priority or oldest one.

The re-check/skip loop is broken: the query only returns waiting rows, and if a candidate were not waiting, `refresh(); continue;` would re-run the same query forever instead of skipping to the next ticket.
The fairness history filters on `status = called` rather than on tickets that have a `called_at`, so called tickets that later moved to another status would drop out of the last-3 history.
The new paragraph is inserted in the middle of an existing sentence, which breaks the document.
A new H2 section is inserted between the '### Call Panel' heading and its table, which breaks the document structure; the CHANGELOG is also not updated.
There is an unused `Model` import and a leftover uncertainty comment ('status enum string? check'), and the imports are unsorted, which Pint will flag.
The ordering is built in two separate places with a redundant `case Any: default:`; one ordering per filter would be clearer.

review.summary: The change adds the CallMode enum, the NoWaitingTicketsException and a CallNextTicket action that locks the queue and applies the fairness rule, and it touches the two docs. The action cannot run because TicketStatus is never imported. The priority-only and normal-only modes have no ordering, the skip-on-concurrent-call loop is broken, no tests ship, and both doc edits corrupt the existing text, so the change needs substantial rework.
